attempts.summary: Mapped the real 4-node topology (node3-node1 access link; node1-node2 dual transit links; node2-node4 access link), then configured persistent policy-based routing so node3's TCP/8080 traffic to node4 traverses Transit Network 1 end-to-end and TCP/9090 traffic traverses Transit Network 2 end-to-end, both reaching node4 successfully in both directions. Verified this survives a full sequential restart of all four nodes with boot-identity proof and post-restart functional re-verification.
